name: greenlogix-monorepo
description: EcoMiles — B2B Urban Logistics Optimization & GLEC-aligned Carbon Estimation Platform (not certified)

scripts.dev:api: cd apps/api && uv run uvicorn greenlogix_api.main:app --port 8000 --reload
scripts.deploy:landing: pnpm --filter @greenlogix/landing exec wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name=greenlogix --branch=main --commit-dirty=true
scripts.deploy:ecomiles: pnpm --filter @greenlogix/landing exec wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name=ecomiles --branch=main --commit-dirty=true
